# IleZa.pl — Used Tech Price Radar & Polish Salary Calculator

> Free Polish used-tech / electronics price radar, dated editorial fair-price histories, and full Polish employment contract calculator by Bahdan Hal.

## Primary pages

- [Editorial fair-price index](https://ileza.pl/en/): manual judgments about what products are reasonably worth, with dated histories
- [Redakcyjny indeks uczciwych cen](https://ileza.pl/): polska wersja indeksu (iPhone, MacBook, RAM, GPU, konsole)
- [Kalkulator wynagrodzeń 2026](https://ileza.pl/kalkulator-wynagrodzen): porównanie kosztu pracodawcy i wypłaty netto dla UoP, zlecenie, o dzieło, B2B oraz Spółki z o.o. (powołanie zarządu)
- [Baza wiedzy i poradniki](https://ileza.pl/blog/): poradniki zakupowe, checklisty weryfikacji sprzętu i analizy opłacalności

## Ecosystem applications

- [Bahdan Hal Portfolio](https://bahdanhal.pl/): engineering consulting and backend architecture
- [StackHal](https://stackhal.com/): developer tools and web infrastructure diagnostics

## Data access

- Public read-only MCP endpoint: `https://ileza.pl/mcp`
- Public MCP tools: `list_polish_used_price_products`, `get_polish_used_price_product`, `get_polish_used_price_history`, `calculate_polish_income_comparison`.
- No account or API key is required for public tools.

## Important limitations

Fair-price values are subjective manual editorial judgments, not statistical samples, scraped listings, algorithmic valuations, completed-sale statistics, or purchasing advice. Visitors may privately submit a public sales-page link as additional context; links are never fetched automatically or published, and seller data or page text is not retained.
